verdict.rationale: Seeing and managing live sessions is a fair question for a remote-desktop host, so the axis applies. The evidence never documents a host view of currently connected guests or a way to disconnect or revoke a device. App-level guest permissions, Teams audit logs, admin-panel access provisioning and time-limited guest credits are adjacent controls, not the requested live-session list or kick/revoke capability.

support.subject: As a power user, the host shows who is connected right now, and I can disconnect or revoke a device from the host
